CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Kripa Shankar Nanda, Advocate For the State : M/s. Ruby Pandey, A.P.P.
-----
03/04.10.2024 Heard the parties

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with POCSO Case No. 12 of 2024 arising out of T. Tanger P.S. Case No. 14 of 2024, for the offences registered under Section 376 (3) of the I.P.C. and under Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences, pending in the Court of Smt. Asha Devi Bhatt, learned Additional Sessions Judge-1-cum-Special Judge, POCSO Act, Simdega.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner is said to have raped the prosecutrix who is a widow lady.
The statement of the victim recorded during the trial has been brought on record by filing supplementary affidavit.
From perusal of which it appears that the prosecutrix has given a complete go-bye to the prosecution case and she has been declared hostile.
In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Smt.
